register.labelZh: CALL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: call around 可以表示致電多個地方;call back 可以表示回覆電話;call up 則可以表示致電某人或機構。；你可以用 call by 表示短暫探訪、用 call on 表示探望親友,也可以用 call in、call out 和 call over表示叫人前來。；call for 可以表達公開要求;call on somebody to do something 可以表達正式呼籲;call oncourage 或 strength 則可以表示運用內在力量。；call forth 可以描述引起的反應;call something off 可以表示取消活動;call something in 則可以表示收回不安全產品。
register.summaryEn: Call around lets you contact several places, call back lets you return a call, and call up lets you telephone a particular person or organisation. You can call by for a short visit, call on a relative, call an expert in, call a worker out or call somebody over. Call for can express a public demand, call on somebody to do something can express a formal request, and call on courage or strength can show the use of inner resources. Call forth can describe a reaction, call something off can cancel an event, and call something in can show that unsafe products are being returned.
